title: RED-O — Kubernetes runtime threat detection
capabilities: Tetragon/eBPF and optional Kubernetes Audit collection
Event-time alignment, rules and correlation with source event IDs
JSONL retention and independent ClickHouse Ingester
Web UI with local authentication and JSONL fallback
Read-only diagnostics and offline/live rule verification
Quality evaluation with telemetry coverage and latency metrics
limitations: Laboratory prototype; no production certification or attack blocking
R022 requires a separately controlled privilege-raise experiment
R017 test detects access to a named file path, not necessarily Unix-socket communication
R011 kprobe sees a capability-change attempt, not verified escalation
Missing TracingPolicy or Kubernetes Audit limits telemetry coverage
Replay is synthetic; Live rule smoke does not measure real-world precision or recall
Source distribution contains no executable RED-O binary or private runtime data
